handoff_rank.title: Android onboarding should request and explain camera permission for QR setup
handoff_rank.suggested_fix: At the Android onboarding QR scan boundary, distinguish scanner startup failure from CAMERA permission denied or permanently denied. Preserve Google Code Scanner permissionless behavior by default; only when local camera permission is actually denied should the UI reuse the existing permission request or open-app-settings affordance and show a specific inline error.
suggested_tests: Real Android device proof: deny camera, tap Scan setup code, verify permission prompt or inline denied state; permanently deny camera and verify app-settings action.
handoff_rank.risk: Google Code Scanner is normally permissionless for the app, so Automation B must not add an unconditional CAMERA prompt before every scan. Real Android device proof is still needed for denied and permanently-denied UX.
